meta.name: arize-experiment
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when creating, running, or analyzing Arize experiments. Also use when the user wants to evaluate or measure model performance, compare models (including GPT-4, Claude, or others), or assess how well their AI is doing. Covers experiment CRUD, exporting runs, comparing results, and evaluation workflows using the ax CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、运行和分析AI模型实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估和比较AI模型性能
copy.tagline_en: Create, run, and analyze AI model experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and compare AI model performance

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以使用 ax CLI 创建、运行和分析 Arize 实验，包括管理实验（增删查）、导出运行结果、比较不同模型性能，以及进行评估工作流。
howto.when: 当你说“创建实验”、“评估模型”，或要求比较 GPT-4、Claude 等模型的性能时触发。

say.text: 用 ax CLI 创建名为“gpt-4o-baseline”的实验。
导出最近实验的运行结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the ax CLI to create, run, and analyze Arize experiments, including CRUD operations, exporting runs, comparing models (e.g., GPT-4, Claude), and performing evaluation workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create experiment", "evaluate model", or ask to compare performance of GPT-4, Claude, etc.

say_en.text: Create an experiment named "gpt-4o-baseline" using ax CLI.
Export the runs of the latest experiment.
say_en.note: Claude will use `ax experiments export` to get JSON.
